```yaml
name: Build and Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
        node-version: [14, 16, 18, 20, 24]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Upgrade parse-github-url
      run: npm install parse-github-url@1.0.4

    - name: Remove vendored parseGitHubUrl.ts
      run: rm src/lib/parseGitHubUrl.ts

    - name: Restore version-util.ts and gitTags.ts
      run: |
        cp src/lib/version-util.ts.bak src/lib/version-util.ts
        cp src/package-managers/gitTags.ts.bak src/package-managers/gitTags.ts

    - name: Restore escapeRegExp import
      run: sed -i 's|import { escapeRegExp } from \'lodash/escapeRegExp\';||' src/lib/wildcardRegex.ts
      run: echo "import { escapeRegExp } from 'lodash/escapeRegExp';" >> src/lib/wildcardRegex.ts

    - name: Run tests
      run: npm test
```
